## Candy Rankings Data {.unnumbered}


### Description

Simplified version with only candy name, chocolate indicator,
sugar percentile, price percentile, and win percentage.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>candy_simple
</code></pre>


### Format

A data frame with 85 rows and 5 variables:


<dl>
<dt>competitorname</dt><dd>The name of the candy
</dd>
<dt>chocolate</dt><dd>Contains chocolate? (0=No, 1=Yes)
</dd>
<dt>sugarpercent</dt><dd>Sugar percentile within dataset
</dd>
<dt>pricepercent</dt><dd>Unit price percentile
</dd>
<dt>winpercent</dt><dd>Win percentage from 269,000 matchups
</dd>
</dl>



### Source

FiveThirtyEight candy power rankings
